column1: # patrol-routes.tsv -- the formal rounds manifest (2026-09-12, operator
# directive "rounds and patrols"). One row per patrol: the surface it walks,
# the deterministic check it runs (pure function over existing ledgers and
# commands -- no model calls), the cadence tier that mounts it, and the
# bestiary finding-class its FAILs file under. Consumed by jobs/patrol.py;
# cadence/day/27-patrol.sh (heavier surfaces). A FAIL files a report-queue
# automation/digest/PATROL-<date>.md; the same patrol+cause on two
# consecutive runs auto-queues a research-subjects entry (the patrol finds
# the pattern, the research beat crystallizes the lesson).
#   patrol-id     stable id, also the report-queue identity suffix
#   surface       what is being walked (record prose / findings doc)
#   check         CHECKS function name in jobs/patrol.py
#   freq-tier     cadence tier: 30m (quick surfaces) | day (heavy surfaces)
#   finding-class bestiary class for the filed alert (lib/causes.sh)
